title: Campaign
description: A funded, time-boxed marketing effort. The budget holder every promo and coupon charges against.

name.description: Internal name the marketer recognises. Never shown to a customer.

objective.description: What the campaign is trying to move. Drives which report it appears in.

state.description: Lifecycle position. Mirrors the redemption-events state machine.

budget.description: Total the campaign may give away. Reaching it stops every promo it funds.

spent.description: Sum of redemptions charged so far. Eventually consistent with the redemption log.

segment-id.description: Default audience for promos in this campaign; each promo may narrow it further.

starts-at.description: First instant any promo in this campaign may serve.

ends-at.description: Exclusive end of the campaign, whatever budget is left.
